build_conv: build a convolution layer using build_conv with specified in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, and weight_init strategy
build_bn: build a batch normalization layer using build_bn with name like bn, sync_bn, gn, or frozen_bn
build_se: build a squeeze-and-excitation module using build_se with se, se_fc, or se_hsig variants for channel attention
build_residual_connect: build a residual connection using build_residual_connect with optional drop_connect_rate and projection downsampling
create_ConvBNRelu: create a ConvBNRelu block that combines convolution, batch norm, and activation with configurable upsample support
